text:
chris_customer: Hi team — I redeemed promo code REDWOOD-2024 on account 0x1234 earlier, UI shows "promo accepted", but my credits/balance are still $0 and API calls are consuming paid tokens. Request #7890. Screenshot: https://i.example/snap.png

tara_support: sorry about that — can you confirm the account email and the exact promo code you used? are you using the same API key you used to sign up?

chris_customer: email is chris@acme.co, promo = REDWOOD-2024 (copied from email). API key prefix: rk_live_abc123 (last 4 chars 3123). I ran a quick check: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer rk_live_abc123" https://api.redwood.example/v1/accounts/0x1234/credits
# -> { "balance_usd": 0, "promos": ["REDWOOD-2024"] }
```
Billing history shows a line: "Promo redeemed: REDWOOD-2024 — applied to invoice #0" (no invoice outstanding tho).

billing_bot: [system] Promo REDWOOD-2024 registered for account 0x1234 at 2024-04-13T12:05:02Z. Applied object: subscription/attach (applied_to_invoice=true).

josh_billing: thanks for the details. looks like the promo was attached to the subscription/invoice object rather than credited to the account balance — that can happen when promo service runs after billing job creates a zero-dollar invoice. I can manually grant the credit while we investigate. Are you ok with a manual $100 credit to your account to resolve immediately? :+1:

chris_customer: yes please, that would be great. would prefer credits usable immediately for API usage. thanks.

sam_engineer: fyi engineering note on repro: if promo redemption webhook arrives after invoice generation within the same minute, our billing worker marks promo as invoice-level credit (invoice.adjustments) instead of account balance. reproducer: create acct, trigger invoice generation (trial->postpaid), then POST /promos/redeem with webhook delay 0.5-2s. filing a bug.

sam_engineer: temp internal command to apply credit (for billing team):
```
# internal admin only
admin_cli apply_credit --account 0x1234 --amount 10000 --currency USD --reason "promo-misapplied:REDWOOD-2024"
```

josh_billing: applied $100 manual credit to account 0x1234 and cleared the invoice attachment. You should see balance updated now. I also set a tag on the promo to prevent double-apply while eng pushes a fix.

billing_bot: [system] Manual credit applied to 0x1234 by josh_billing at 2024-04-13T13:10:07Z. New balance_usd: 100.00

liz_success: chris — we've added $100 in account credits; they should be visible in the console under Billing -> Credits and usable for API calls immediately. Sorry about the confusion, we're also opening an eng ticket to prevent recurrence. Would you like a short postmortem once fixed?

chris_customer: saw it, thanks! API calls now draw from promo credit. Appreciate the fast help.

tara_support: marking this thread resolved for now. internal ticket: BIL-4523 created, assigned to eng (sam_engineer).

sam_engineer: I'll pick up BIL-4523. plan: add idempotency to promo webhook processing and ensure promos landing after invoice creation are converted to account-level credits. ETA for patch: 1 week, will post updates here.

liz_success: noted — we'll follow up with the customer if anything else needed. :rocket:
